title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1972-10-17
lineage: MSR> C> DATs> CDRs> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 show with a smoking Playin' and stellar PitB highlights.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clean and well‑balanced, though it suffers from a noticeable cut in Black Peter and several missing songs. Musically the performance is vibrant – the first set shines with a monster Playin', half‑step and Sugar Magnolia, while the second set delivers a powerful PitB and solid jams despite some uneven moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the show’s energy and key performances (Playin', PitB, Sugar Magnolia) while noting only minor recording glitches and missing tracks; this yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and crisp sound overall; occasional cut in the middle of Black Peter and several omitted songs, but no major distortion or noise issues.

standout_songs: The Other One (NFA > GDTRFB > NFA sequence)
poor_songs: Missing: Strawberry, Fire on the Mountain, Big River, Jack Straw, Foolish Heart, etc.
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is tight and high‑energy with strong segues; second set holds its own with a monster PitB but some reviewers felt it lacked a deep jam vehicle compared to the first.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for an inspiring solo and overall great tone throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: "On fire" – bass work highlighted as exceptional by multiple reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Tasty guitar licks noted; occasional vocal quirks mentioned but overall solid contribution.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith (or other keyboardist) singled out as a star of the performance in one detailed review.
